task.title: Clean up Repo for sharing
task.description:
I want to get this project in a good state to open source it. Some things I think that need to get cleaned up.

Update the benchmarking suite:
 - Remove the docs folder, including historical benchmark performance docs, evidence & plans
 - Move specs into a top-level folder (no more docs/superpowers)
 - Have a benchmarking script that can be run and outputs a report of the results. We no longer need to keep thresholds and validate pass fail, as the current app is in a good spot so just being able to run a report and compare that with new changes lets us know if the baseline shifts

Overall documentation updates:
 - Make sure the README is up to date and provides clear installation/usage instructions, including instructions for those who want to build from source and modify the code themselves
 - Add Debian OSD software license

Scripts:
 - A review and cleanup of all the scripts currently in the repo. What needs to be here as part of open sourcing the code, and what are personal use-case scripts that should be pulled out of the repo and stored in a local directory for my own use?

Security audit:
 - Are my .github/workflows secure?
 - Is any personal/private info being leaked?
 - Repository-specific security settings that should be implemented
